decision: HAMCP-371 exact ha-mcp 9.2.0 admission (51e3aac7, official OCI images only) with the 9.1.2 dispositions. Seventeen descriptors changed from 9.1.2 (listed, from the S4 diff); the other 60, including the dashboard getter, are byte-identical. Standalone tools/list captured twice per filesystem profile (77 and 82 tools); the exact amd64 App image produced byte-identical catalogues in both (profiles-1, profiles-2); the arm64 App image is pinned by digest only. No _meta.ha_mcp.policy block. The dashboard attestation is quarantined until SB; ha_get_history refuses before dispatch until S9; ha_get_hacs_info stays unsupported; ha_get_operation_status stays held; backup, HACS, issue-report and integration-write tools stay unreachable. The 9.2.0 release page lists no assets (read 2026-11-15). Local candidate only; CI, independent review, installed admission, publication and version change are separate gates.
